About the Team 
 DoorDash's mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about – helping grow business and the communities that support those businesses.
 About the Role 
 We’re looking for a business-savvy operator with a strong bias toward action to lead DoorDash Canada’s expansion and marketplace performance. As the national expansion lead, you’ll blend strategic thinking with operational excellence to identify growth opportunities, build strong internal partnerships, and improve customer and merchant experiences across the country.
 This role requires a proactive self-starter who thrives at the intersection of data, process management, and execution. Whether analyzing performance metrics for a new launch or engaging with cross-functional partners, you’ll uncover ways to improve market performance. Expansion is core to DoorDash Canada's growth, and we need someone who can apply best practices and right-size them for local geographies to ensure we are building a lasting product for our customers.
 We’re seeking someone who’s data-driven, a hands-on operator, relationship-oriented, and eager to make a tangible impact by positioning DoorDash as Canada's top platform.
 You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… 
 Own and execute the Canada expansion strategy : Build and execute a national roadmap focused on increasing our footprint while ensuring launch markets perform to expectations through rigorous marketplace management.
 Tactically run end-to-end execution : Lead the expansion lifecycle from initial strategy and buy-in through to execution, ensuring every launch is set up for long-term success.
 Right-size best practices : Apply proven operational frameworks while localizing strategies based on the specific marketplace dynamics of diverse Canadian cities.
 Lead cross-functional collaboration : Act as the connective tissue between the expansion team and DoorDash’s commercial units, surfacing insights and co-developing strategies that support national growth.
 Build strong internal relationships : Partner effectively with stakeholders across Dasher, Sales, Merchant, and Marketing teams to ensure a unified approach to marketplace health.
 Act like an Owner : Take full ownership of the success of our growth markets, with the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale what works across the country
 We’re excited about you because you have… 
 Are a builder and connector : You see opportunities where others see roadblocks. You’re energized by building systems from the ground up and forming lasting relationships along the way
 Have an operational mindset : You understand how to identify, scope, and execute high-impact initiatives, and you know how to align internal stakeholders to get things done.
 Thrive in ambiguity and autonomy : You’re comfortable setting your own direction, testing and learning as you go, and staying laser-focused on outcomes.
 Are operationally sharp and analytically driven : You turn insights into action and know how to measure and report on impact in a fast-moving environment.
 Qualifications 
 4+ years of experience in business development, consulting, strategy, startups, or operations
 Demonstrated experience working cross-functionally with commercial teams 
 Proven ability to identify growth opportunities and lead strategic initiatives from conception to execution
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence across various stakeholders and levels of the organization
 Proficient in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL; comfortable making decisions grounded in data
 Compensation 
 Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location. 
 In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.
 DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.
 Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.
 To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here .
 The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.
 $116,000 — $145,000 CAD 
 About DoorDash 
 At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
 DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. 
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 
 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

 If so, join our team! Enjoy a work-life balance, meet new people, and be a part of a team of On-Call Crossing Guards who love their jobs - some have worked as OSC Crossing Guards for 20 years (and counting!)!
 On-Call crossing guards must have their own vehicle.

 On-Call crossing guards must be available daily for all shifts, Mon-Fri. 
 Here's what you'll do as a Crossing Guard 
 Crossing Guards cover shifts at the morning school bell times for student arrival, lunchtime bells and afternoon school bell times for student dismissal. Crossing Guards are responsible for ensuring that children travelling to and from school pass safely through their assigned crossing. Crossing Guards are safety figures and are important and engaged members of the community that keep our children safe.

 Direct and escort pedestrians across the street, stopping traffic as necessary.
 Communicate traffic, crossing rules, and other information to students and adults.
 Report unsafe student behaviour to school officials.
 Inspect your intersection on a daily basis and report any unsafe conditions.
 Monitor traffic flow to locate safe gaps through which pedestrians can cross. Create safe gaps in high traffic situations by asserting your authority to stop traffic.
 Be aware of emergency vehicles approaching the area and ensure that they have priority over vehicular and pedestrian traffic.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 Get to know the team
 The Developer Platform team at Auth0 (an Okta company) owns the platform that developers build identity on. Increasingly they build alongside AI agents, and that raises the bar on everything underneath: interfaces have to hold up whether a person or an agent is calling them, and the systems behind them have to stay reliable and coherent as usage grows. We move fast, we own problems end to end, and we care deeply about the platform we put in front of the developers and agents who depend on it.
 The opportunity
 We're hiring a Principal Engineer (P5) to serve as the technical leader and compass for the Developer Platform team. You'll work across the breadth of the platform, tackling the highly complex, vaguely specified problems that span it and turning them into clear technical direction the team can execute against, without day-to-day oversight. Above all, you'll own how the platform is architected to scale: the distributed systems behind it, the reliability and consistency guarantees developers depend on, and the coherence that keeps it easy to build on as usage grows. You'll champion the team's technical execution, raise the engineering bar, mentor the people around you, and partner with tech leads across teams to keep the wider platform aligned. You'll have real influence over how our platform holds up in a world where developers and agents are both first-class consumers.
 What you'll be doing
 Own the platform architecture: Set the technical direction for the developer platform, and make the cross-cutting decisions that keep it coherent and easy to build on as it grows.
 Architect for scale: Design the distributed systems behind the platform for throughput, reliability, and consistency, so the guarantees developers depend on hold up under real load.
 Turn ambiguity into direction: Take the hardest, most vaguely specified platform problems and turn them into clear, modular technical designs the team can execute against.
 Design for developers and agents: Shape the platform so it holds up whether a person or an agent is calling it, and so both can build and automate their work against Auth0.
 Raise the engineering bar: Set the standard for how the team designs, builds, and operates the platform, and lead deep, constructive reviews that grow the engineers around you.
 Partner across teams: Operate peer-to-peer with tech leads in adjacent groups to review major architectural decisions and keep the wider platform aligned.
 What you'll bring

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

This position sits within Ramp’s Channel team and reports to Partner Consulting. In this role, you’ll build and scale Ramp’s long-term System Integrator (SI)-led implementation program. You’ll enable a broad ecosystem of implementation partners to support a meaningful volume of Ramp-referred customers, deliver high-quality implementations, and extend the capacity of Ramp’s Customer Success organization.

 

Ramp’s current SI pilot is the starting point - not the end state. You’ll translate the pilot’s learnings into the operating model, technical readiness, commercial foundations, and quality controls required to scale responsibly from an initial cohort to a broad network of partners across products, ERP ecosystems, and geographies.

 

You’ll be Ramp’s technical and programmatic owner for SI delivery: enabling partners to implement Ramp successfully, defining clear scope and certification standards, measuring implementation quality and customer outcomes, and turning field learnings into improvements across product, enablement, and partner strategy.

 

This is a senior IC role, not a people-management role. You’ll need equal credibility in technical implementation conversations and commercial partner-program design, working closely with Channel Partner Managers, Solutions, Customer Success, Product, Product Operations, Accounting Integrations, Legal, Security, and Finance.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and scale the SI operating model, including partner segmentation, certification tiers, service packages, implementation methodology, scope boundaries, escalation paths, quality standards, and performance management.

 - Own partner readiness and technical enablement across Ramp configuration, ERP integrations, data migration, testing, cutover, and customer change management - defining what partners can deliver independently, when Ramp co-delivery is required, and what remains out of scope.

 - Lead responsible program expansion across new products, ERP ecosystems, and geographies; set readiness gates for complex offerings such as Procurement, and influence Product, Product Operations, Product Marketing, and Accounting Integrations using structured field feedback.




WHAT YOU NEED

 Fondé par le professeur Yoshua Bengio de l’Université de Montréal, Mila rassemble des chercheurs spécialisés en intelligence artificielle et plus précisément en apprentissage automatique, apprentissage profond et apprentissage par renforcement. Reconnu mondialement pour ses importantes contributions au domaine de l’apprentissage profond, Mila s’est particulièrement distingué dans la modélisation du langage, la traduction automatique, la reconnaissance d’objets et les modèles génératifs. Depuis 2017, Mila est le fruit d’une collaboration entre l’Université de Montréal et l’Université McGill, en lien étroit avec Polytechnique Montréal et HEC Montréal.
 Mila s’est donné pour mission d’être un pôle mondial d’avancées scientifiques qui inspire l’innovation et l’essor de l’intelligence artificielle (IA) au bénéfice de tous.
 Pour en connaitre davantage, veuillez consulter https://mila.quebec/ 
 Sommaire du poste
 Le Lab d'IA souveraine est une nouvelle initiative de Mila visant à assembler une pile (un stack)  d'inférence IA open source prête pour l'entreprise, que les organisations peuvent déployer et exploiter sur des infrastructures sous leur contrôle. Elle combine le service de modèles, la recherche d'information (RAG), l'orchestration d'agents et l'observabilité, avec un plan de contrôle pour les gérer comme un produit unique.
 Sous la responsabilité du directeur principal de l'ingénierie logicielle, vous concevrez et maintiendrez les paquets de déploiement et l'automatisation de la pile d'IA. Ceux-ci permettront aux partenaires de déployer, mettre à jour et restaurer la pile sur leur propre infrastructure, depuis un nœud unique jusqu'à des grappes Kubernetes en production. Vous travaillerez avec l'équipe d'intégration pour paqueter leurs composants et les déployer dans des environnements de référence à l'aide de flux de travail partagés. Vous recommandez des technologies de plateforme sur la base de tests reproductibles, d'exigences opérationnelles et de la pertinence de l'architecture. Ce rôle ne comprend pas de support de production ni de garde (on-call).
 La réussite de ce rôle signifie que les partenaires peuvent déployer, mettre à jour, restaurer et exploiter la pile de manière autonome dans des environnements pris en charge, à l'aide d'automatismes et de guides d'utilisation (runbooks) vérifiés.
 Principales responsabilités
 Évaluer les composants de chaque couche de la pile. Développer une connaissance approfondie de leurs capacités, de leurs limites et de leur adéquation avec l'architecture.
 Tester les composants candidats par des expérimentations, des bancs d'essai reproductibles et des déploiements pilotes. Documenter les méthodes et les résultats pour appuyer les décisions techniques.
 Collaborer avec le responsable technique pour recommander des composants et des approches d'intégration basés sur les résultats de tests, les besoins du projet et les exigences opérationnelles.
 Intégrer les composants sélectionnés en production via de la configuration et des tests d'interopérabilité. Effectuer à l'occasion des contributions en amont (upstream) ou rédiger de petits conteneurs d'accompagnement (sidecars) d'intégration au besoin.
 Concevoir et maintenir les flux de travail CI pour tester l'intégration des composants. Automatiser la configuration, le déploiement, les mises à jour et la restauration à l'aide de flux de travail de livraison partagés.
 S'assurer que les composants attribués respectent les exigences de sécurité, d'observabilité et du plan de contrôle.
 Soutenir les déploiements pilotes, diagnostiquer les pannes et améliorer la fiabilité, les performances et l'efficacité des ressources. Travailler avec l'ingénieur·e plateforme sur les modifications d'infrastructure nécessaires.
 Maintenir la documentation d'intégration, les enregistrements de bancs d'essai, les guides d'utilisation (runbooks) et les instructions d'exploitation afin que les ingénieurs et les organisations pilotes puissent déployer et exploiter les composants de manière autonome.

 Founded by Professor Yoshua Bengio of the Université de Montréal, Mila brings together researchers specializing in artificial intelligence, and more specifically in machine learning, deep learning and reinforcement learning.  Mila's mission is to be a global hub of scientific advances that inspires innovation and the rise of artificial intelligence (AI) for the benefit of all.

 Position Summary
 The Sovereign AI Lab is a new Mila initiative to assemble an enterprise-ready, open-source AI inference stack that organizations can deploy and operate on infrastructure they control. About AI Acquisition 
 AI Acquisition is a bootstrapped, multi-entity business helping founders and operators scale with AI. We combine SaaS platforms, consulting, and a full sales and delivery engine. We manage thousands of active clients across multiple products and operate globally.
 The Role 
 You're taking over an existing book of established client relationships. These are not new clients figuring out what they bought. They've been with us, they know the product, and they have expectations built on months of experience with the business.
 Your job is to keep them progressing, keep them retained, and keep them expanding. That means understanding where each client actually is in their business, what's working, what's stuck, and what they need next. Not checking in for the sake of it. Actually moving the needle on their results.
 This is a consulting role disguised as account management. You're not managing a spreadsheet of renewals. You're advising business owners on how to grow: how to frame their offer, how to think about their funnel, how to close deals, how to handle fulfillment, and how to use AI to do all of it faster.
 The clients you inherit will have history, context, and in some cases, frustrations that predate you. Your first job is to audit that book, understand every account's real status, and earn trust through competence rather than promises.
 What You'll Own 
 An established portfolio of legacy clients across various stages of maturity and engagement
 Regular check-ins, growth workshops, and strategic conversations with business owners who are building and scaling real companies
 Client retention — spotting risk before it becomes a refund conversation, re-engaging clients who've gone quiet, and resolving issues without escalation
 Business consulting — advising clients on offer framing, lead generation strategy, sales process, prospecting, closing, and fulfillment. You need to understand these well enough to coach, not just relay information
 Upsell identification — knowing when a client is ready for more and positioning the next step as the natural move, not a sales pitch
 Cross-functional coordination with the onboarding, deliverables, and office hours teams to make sure nothing falls through the cracks
 Documentation — every interaction, decision, and next step logged so anyone picking up your account knows exactly where things stand
 What We Need From You 
 Native or near-native English fluency is non-negotiable. You will be on camera with clients daily and every conversation needs to land with clarity and confidence
 Direct experience as a CSM, account manager, or business consultant where you personally advised clients on how to start, grow, or scale a business. Not just managed the relationship, actually consulted on the business itself
 You understand the mechanics of lead generation, sales funnels, cold email, LinkedIn outreach, and how they connect to a client's revenue. You don't need to execute campaigns yourself but you need to diagnose why one isn't converting and coach the client through it
 You've managed a portfolio of clients where retention and expansion were your responsibility, not someone else's
 You're comfortable with difficult conversations. Clients who are frustrated, clients who are stuck, clients who need honest feedback about their own execution. You handle these with composure and directness
 You come with solutions, not just problems. When something breaks in a client's journey, your instinct is to propose the fix, not report the issue and wait
 You pick things up fast. The biggest challenge for external hires in this role has been the knowledge gap — there is a lot to learn about our products, processes, and client journeys, and you need to absorb it quickly enough to be credible in front of clients within weeks, not months
 You're comfortable with AI tools and either already use them in your work or will learn without being told to
 This Is Not For You If 
 You only know relationship management without the business consulting layer. "Keeping clients happy" is not the job. Moving their business forward is
 You need months to ramp before you can have a real conversation with a client. Our clients won't wait that long
 You're uncomfortable advising business owners on sales, prospecting, or offer strategy. That's a core part of the role, not a nice-to-have
 You avoid hard conversations or tell clients what they want to hear instead of what they need to hear
 You wait to be told what's wrong rather than finding it yourself
 What Success Looks Like 
 Your clients are progressing, not just retained. Business results, not just satisfaction scores
 Clients at risk are flagged and handled before they escalate. You're the person who prevents the refund conversation, not the one having it
 You've audited your book within the first two weeks and can articulate every client's real status, not what's in the notes
 You're coaching clients on their business, not just updating them on deliverables
 You pick up the product knowledge fast enough to be credible in front of clients by week three
 You adopt new tools and processes without being chased
 The Environment 
 This is a high-performance, remote-first team at the cutting edge of AI-powered business building.
 Direct access to department heads from day one
 Strong performers progress quickly based on what they deliver, not tenure
 Exposure to AI-led systems and tools daily
 Autonomy and ownership over your portfolio
 A team that holds a high bar and expects the same from everyone
 This role operates as an independent contractor engagement: invoice-based, permanent structure, regulated notice periods on both sides. We expect 50 to 60 hours a week from our best people, not as a crunch but as the natural shape of work that matters.
 If you're looking for structure handed to you, this isn't the right place. If you want to be the one "Lifting the Hood", build something real, and raise the bar every week with a team that moves fast, we want to talk.

We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About the Role

We are looking for a leader to build and scale our Support Engineering team, which will collaborate directly with our strategic enterprise accounts, our product and engineering teams, as well as our field teams to solve some of the most difficult technical problems faced by our customers. You will lead one of the best technical troubleshooting teams at OpenAI, and our customers and Engineering teams will look to you for technical guidance in addressing the most technically difficult issues in our environment. You will play an integral role in building knowledge within the team and be part of strategic initiatives for organizational and process improvements. Working directly with our most strategic customers - You will be crucial to the success of the most innovative, disruptive, and high-scale AI solutions being built with the OpenAI platform.

This team will handle high difficulty situations and issues. The team will be global, providing 24x7 technical coverage for our customers. This will be an opportunity to build this new team from first principles - your leadership will determine the future of this organization.

This Toronto-based role is currently remote and is expected to transition to an in-office arrangement.

 - Build and lead a team of the foremost technical and troubleshooting experts at OpenAI. You are the last line of defense before the core Engineering team.

 Position Summary  
 The People AI Solutions Designer is the builder. Where the People AI Deployment Lead readies HR processes for automation, the Solutions Designer takes that readied work and builds it — rapidly prototyping, coding, and shipping the agents, automations, and lightweight apps that solve real HR problems.   
 This is a hands-on craft role for someone who moves quickly from problem to working prototype to production. The Designer “vibe-builds” and assembles solutions in low-code and agent platforms and dropping into code where it is faster or better — and partners closely with the Deployment Lead, HR Systems, and McKesson Technology to put durable solutions into the hands of HR. Select solutions may be managed from idea to launch from within HR with limited oversight, and more complex solutions may require a handoff to MT to fully implement.   
 Key Responsibilities  
 Translate Readied Workflows into Technical Designs  (20%)  
 Take defined inputs, outputs, decision points, and ownership and turn them into a concrete solution design or mockup.  
 Make pragmatic build decisions — what an agent handles, what is automated, what stays human — and flag where a process needs more readiness before it can be built.  
 Build & Prototype Solutions  (30%)  
 Build agents, automations, and lightweight apps that solve the HR problems surfaced and readied by process owners across HR & partners within the Workforce Innovation team  
 Rapidly prototype — turn a readied workflow into a working build quickly, favoring momentum and learning over perfection, then refine based on user feedback  
 Build across low-code and agent platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot Studio / Power Platform, ServiceNow, Moveworks) and drop into code (Python, scripting, APIs) where it is the better tool.  
 Lead the prototype and build, partnering closely with UX designer for interface designs and McKesson Technology for complex enterprise solutions  
 Iterate from Real Usage  (20%)  
 Pilot solutions with real users, instrument them, and improve based on actual usage and performance.  
 Tune prompts, logic, and integrations to raise quality, reliability, and experience.  
 Harden, Document & Hand to Operations  (15%)  
 Harden solutions for production including error handling, guardrails, data handling, and monitoring and document how they work. Fully ready the solution for transition and lifecycle management.  
 Hand solutions to HR Systems / operations / COE owners for ongoing ownership, in line with the standards set by the Deployment Lead.  
 Maintain a Reusable Build Toolkit & Standards  (15%)  
 Build and curate reusable components, patterns, and templates so each new solution ships faster than the last.  
 Contribute to shared build, security, and quality standards for AI and automation in HR.  
 What Success Looks Like  
 Readied HR workflows are turned into working, deployed solutions on a short cycle.  
 Solutions are reliable in production, well-documented, and cleanly handed to operations.  
 A growing library of reusable components shortens the build time for each new solution.  
 Measurable capacity, cycle-time, and experience gains are realized from shipped builds.  
 Demonstrates a repeatable “ready-then-build” model that scales across HR.  
 Minimum Job Qualifications  
 Education / Training  
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, information systems, design, engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated building experience.  
 Certifications in relevant low-code / agent platforms (e.g., Power Platform, Copilot Studio, ServiceNow) preferred.  
 Business Experience  
 Typically 7+ years of relevant experience building automations, agents, integrations, or applications, consistent with a P5 individual contributor.  
 Demonstrated portfolio of solutions taken from prototype to production. HR or enterprise-process context is a plus.  
 Specialized Knowledge & Skills  
 Fluency with low-code / agent platforms and the ability to drop into code (Python, scripting, APIs) when it is faster or better.  
 Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agent tooling; prompt, logic, and integration design.  
 Comfort with ambiguity; moves from problem to working prototype quickly and iterates from real usage.  
 Builds for reliability, quality, security, and maintainability, and documents and hands off cleanly.  
 Collaboration mindset, working in tight partnership with the HR COE or Process owner, Process Readiness lead, HR Systems, and McKesson Technology.  
 Why This Role Matters  
 This role brings a new skillset (citizen development) out of enterprise technology and in to HR to sit alongside process owners and automate the daily tasks that take administrative lift. Allows for greater strategic capacity, and ensures repeated reliable process handoffs across complex HR teams.  
 The People AI Duo  
 This role is one half of a deliberate two-person operating model for AI and automation in HR. The People AI Deployment Lead goes out across HR to find the work that is ripe for automation and gets it ready for automation. This role, the People AI Solutions Designer, takes that readied work and builds a rapid prototype, and codes, and ships the agents and automations to manage the process. Together the duo can be deployed against any HR process, end to end: one readies, one builds, and a repeatable model for scaling AI across HR takes hold.

About the Team 
 The Merchant is at the core of DoorDash. The Merchant Team, one of the largest in the company, powers many facets of our business and is one of the primary drivers of growth and revenue. On the Merchant Strategy & Ops team, our mission is to have best-in class restaurant selection, build cutting edge services for our merchants to grow their business, and help our partners operate seamlessly.
 About the Role 
 We are looking for an operator with a strong bias to action who loves using data and getting creative to solve problems. You’ll join our Merchant Selection team, where we operate relentlessly towards ensuring we strike the best possible deals with our merchants, to enable us to grow our restaurant selection in a sustainable manner. 
 Selection’s north star is simply to ensure we have the best & most restaurant offering in each neighbourhood we operate in. It sounds simple enough…but of course in practice it’s much more complicated than that. 
 Retention is part of Selection because we believe that signing a merchant isn’t enough. It all means nothing if we churn the merchant a few months later (either poached by a competitor to go exclusive, or the merchant has had a bad experience and chooses to leave…both are equally bad). Since selection is measured on all merchants on the platform meaning we need to acquire + retain as many merchants as possible. It’s also our job to make sure that we’re retaining merchants in a way that not only aligns with our business priorities, but in a way that we can afford.
 Your role here is to critically analyze new and existing partnerships and help us sign/retain our partners either proactively or reactively (i.e., a churn threat or a competitor exclusivity takeover). To do so, you’ll get deep in the data, evaluate renegotiation deals and determine if the requested terms are financially feasible. We need to create the right amount of ‘friction’ to push for the best possible deal. Sometimes we have to hold firm and reject deals, other times we accept deals that may fall outside our WTP. We don’t always get it right, because there is both a science (financial modeling) and an art (intel from the field or strategic decisions) to deal desk and it really just takes multiple reps to get comfortable owning these approvals.
 You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… 
 Strategize – Devise and execute initiatives against the overall Selection strategy, focused on how we can get the most out of our agreements with merchants
 Optimize – Build the best merchant revenue engine so DoorDash continues to offer the highest quality selection for its customers and retain our merchants

Join Shift Collab — Bring Accessible Therapy to Clients Across Canada
 At Shift Collab , we're a women-led, award-winning collective of over 125 Registered Social Workers and Registered Psychotherapists reshaping virtual mental health care across Canada. For the past 8 years, we've partnered with Maple, Canada's premier virtual care platform, to offer true on-demand and scheduled therapy delivered from the comfort of home. 
 We are expanding our network with bilingual therapists who can provide psychotherapy in both English and French. This is an independent contractor role requiring flexible, week-to-week availability. On-demand support means being available for clients needing care in the moment, between 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. EST, seven days a week — on-demand availability is a meaningful part of this role.
 Our Hiring Philosophy
 Our organization is deeply committed to equity and diversity. We wholeheartedly welcome applications from women, members of racialized groups, visible minorities, Aboriginal persons, persons with disabilities, persons of any sexual orientation, and persons of any gender identity or gender expression. We are also committed to ensuring that each individual will have genuine, open, and unhindered access to opportunities within our company. Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodations for interviews or other meetings, please let us know.
 What This Role Actually Looks Like
 Through the Maple platform, you'll deliver two types of sessions each week, for a total of 6 hours of availability:
 On-Demand Sessions: Pick up sessions between 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. EST, seven days a week, for up to 6 hours per week based on demand. Clients connect with you when they need support and you show up ready.
 Scheduled Sessions: Allocate 6 hours per week in the Maple calendar so clients can book directly through the app at a day and time that works for them.
 You'll support clients across a range of presenting concerns, including mood disorders, perfectionism, imposter syndrome, work or school stress, and life transitions.
 What We Offer
 We know your time is best spent with clients, not on administrative overhead. That's why we take care of the things that slow most independent practitioners down:
 Flexible, week-to-week scheduling that works around your existing practice
 A competitive per-session rate, shared during the interview process
 Access to a steady stream of clients through the Maple platform
 A supportive, women-led collective that values your clinical voice
 Platform orientation and setup support so you can hit the ground running
 Billing, admin, and back-office support handled for you
 A long-term partnership with a team that takes quality care seriously
 An accessible point of contact on our Clinical and People & Operations team throughout your time with us
 Who Thrives Here
 You're a strong fit if you:
 Build rapport quickly, earn client trust, and support retention from the first session forward
 Show up consistently for on-demand sessions alongside your scheduled hours
 See quality care as the standard, not the ceiling
 Bring strong clinical judgment and expertise to every session
 Are comfortable working with clients across the lifespan, aged 14 and up
 Want a long-term partnership built on trust, clinical autonomy, and meaningful work
 Are looking to supplement your existing income with flexible, client-focused work
 Are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion in your practice
 What You Bring
 Bilingual and able to offer psychotherapy in both English and French with clinical fluency, meaning you can assess, build rapport, and deliver therapy confidently in either language (required)
 Registered as an MSW RSW or RP in Ontario and/or Quebec, with the ability to see clients in other provinces and territories, or willingness to register in additional provinces
 Master 's-level degree in Social Work or Psychotherapy
 2+ years of post-licensure experience providing individual therapy to adults
 Minimum 6 hours of availability per week on a consistent schedule
 Individual professional liability insurance
 Proficiency with virtual therapy platforms and secure telehealth tools
 Reliable internet and a private, secure workspace
 Ability to practice independently and problem-solve without supervision
 Adherence to program requirements and Shift Collab guidelines
 Professional references and a Vulnerable Sector Check (required for all successful candidates)
 Disclaimer

Shift Collab uses applicant tracking software (Workable) that may include AI-assisted features to help organize, parse, and rank applications. All hiring decisions, including screening, interviewing, and final selection, are made by members of our People & Operations team. AI is used to support our process, not to make decisions on our behalf.
 Rejoignez Shift Collab — Offrez une thérapie accessible aux clients partout au Canada
 Chez Shift Collab, nous sommes un collectif dirigé par des femmes, primé, regroupant plus de 125 travailleurs sociaux et psychothérapeutes agréés qui transforment les soins de santé mentale virtuels à travers le Canada.  Nous élargissons notre réseau avec des thérapeutes bilingues capables d'offrir de la psychothérapie en anglais et en français.  Notre philosophie d'embauche
 Notre organisation est profondément engagée envers l'équité et la diversité. Nous accueillons chaleureusement les candidatures de femmes, de membres de groupes racialisés, de minorités visibles, de personnes autochtones, de personnes en situation de handicap, de personnes de toute orientation sexuelle, ainsi que de personnes de toute identité ou expression de genre.  Par l'entremise de la plateforme Maple, vous offrirez deux types de séances par semaine, pour un total de 6 heures de disponibilité :
 Séances sur demande: Acceptez des séances entre 8 h et 20 h HNE, sept jours sur sept, jusqu'à 6 heures par semaine selon la demande. Les clients se connectent avec vous lorsqu'ils ont besoin de soutien, et vous êtes prêt à les recevoir.
 Séances planifiées: Réservez 6 heures par semaine dans le calendrier Maple afin que les clients puissent prendre rendez-vous directement via l'application, au jour et à l'heure qui leur conviennent.
 Vous accompagnerez des clients présentant diverses problématiques, notamment des troubles de l'humeur, le perfectionnisme, le syndrome de l'imposteur, le stress lié au travail ou aux études, et les transitions de vie.
 Ce que nous offrons

 Une planification flexible, semaine après semaine, qui s'adapte à votre pratique existante 
 Un taux par séance compétitif, communiqué lors du processus d'entretien 
 Un accès à un flux constant de clients via la plateforme Maple 
 Un collectif solidaire dirigé par des femmes qui valorise votre voix clinique 
 Un soutien pour l'orientation et la configuration de la plateforme afin que vous soyez opérationnel rapidement 
 La facturation, l'administration et le soutien administratif pris en charge pour vous

 Un point de contact accessible au sein de notre équipe Ressources humaines et opérations tout au long de votre collaboration avec nous

 Êtes présent de façon constante pour les séances sur demande en parallèle de vos heures planifiées 
 Considérez la qualité des soins comme la norme, et non comme le plafond 
 Apportez un jugement clinique solide et une expertise à chaque séance 
 Êtes à l'aise pour travailler avec des clients de tous âges, à partir de 14 ans 
 Souhaitez un partenariat à long terme fondé sur la confiance, l'autonomie clinique et un travail porteur de sens 
 Cherchez à compléter votre revenu existant grâce à un travail flexible axé sur les clients 
 Êtes engagé envers la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans votre pratique
 Ce que vous apportez
 Être bilingue et capable d’offrir de la psychothérapie en anglais et en français avec une aisance clinique, c’est-à-dire évaluer, créer un lien thérapeutique et intervenir avec confiance dans les deux langues (obligatoire)
 Être inscrit en tant que TSI (travailleur social inscrit) ou psychothérapeute agréé (PA) en Ontario et/ou au Québec, avec la capacité de voir des clients dans d'autres provinces et territoires, ou la volonté de s'inscrire dans des provinces supplémentaires 
 Détenir une maîtrise en travail social ou en psychothérapie 
 Avoir 2 ans ou plus d'expérience post-accréditation en thérapie individuelle auprès d'adultes 
 Avoir une disponibilité minimale de 6 heures par semaine selon un horaire régulier 
 Détenir une assurance responsabilité professionnelle individuelle 
 Maîtriser les plateformes de thérapie virtuelle et les outils sécurisés de télésanté 
 Disposer d'une connexion Internet fiable et d'un espace de travail privé et sécurisé 
 Être capable de pratiquer de manière autonome et de résoudre des problèmes sans supervision 
 Respecter les exigences du programme et les lignes directrices de Shift Collab 
 Fournir des références professionnelles et une vérification du secteur vulnérable (obligatoire pour tous les candidats retenus)
 Avis de transparence
 Dans un souci de transparence, nous souhaitons vous informer de la façon dont nous utilisons l'intelligence artificielle dans ce processus d'embauche. Shift Collab utilise un logiciel de suivi des candidatures (Workable) qui peut inclure des fonctionnalités assistées par l'IA pour aider à organiser, analyser et classer les candidatures. Toutes les décisions d'embauche, y compris la présélection, les entretiens et la sélection finale, sont prises par des membres de notre équipe Ressources humaines et opérations. L'IA est utilisée pour soutenir notre processus, et non pour prendre des décisions en notre nom.

 Durham Community Health Centre (DCHC) is a registered, charitable organization that provides integrated, accessible, and equitable community-based primary care, wellness services, and health education to Durham community members who face multiple barriers to their health and well-being.

 At DCHC, we are a team-based interprofessional group of staff including physicians, nurse practitioners, nurses, counselors, dietitians, outreach workers, medical secretaries, and other administrative staff. We always place every client at the centre of our approach to care, based on their needs. We address these needs through integrated clinical and wellness care and health education.

 Position Overview 
 The Medical Secretary will be a welcoming, effective, collaborative member of the Agency’s Clinical Services, Primary Care inter-professional team.  The Medical Secretary works within the Administrative Support Team (AST) to support our primary care service providers.  These include the Registered Nurses, Nurse Practitioners, Physicians and Dietitians on our Medical Services Team (MST) and the Therapists (Registered Social Workers and Registered Psychotherapists) on our Counselling Services Team (CST) as well as the Interprofessional Care Team (IPC).  Key Responsibilities 
 Actively contributes to developing and maintaining a welcoming environment for Durham CHC clients and our community by demonstrating a non-judgmental, respectful, and accepting approach to client care – whether meeting clients face-to-face or speaking to clients by telephone.

 Share and/or perform the duties of “Receptionist” when required – and effectively connect clients with the right service at the right place, at the right time.
 Opening and closing DCHC facilities from time-to-time, by following established policy and procedures to ensure client timely access to service and that the building is secured.
 Flexibility to work or drive to meetings at any of DCHC clinical locations in our service area, as required.
 Ability to work a flexible schedule with at least one evening per week.
 Actively maintain awareness and understanding of DCHC services and programs.

They are looking for an ERP that does more than record transactions. They want one that helps them anticipate demand, move inventory faster, and fulfill orders accurately. 
 Acumatica is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the product direction for our Distribution Edition. You will translate what wholesale and distribution customers need into a clear roadmap, work side by side with engineering and our partner ecosystem to deliver it and make Acumatica the obvious choice for growing distributors. 
 Distribution Capabilities You Will Own 
 Inventory and warehouse management, order management and fulfillment, purchasing and procurement, pricing and rebates, and demand planning and replenishment. 
 What You'll Do 
 Own the Distribution Roadmap 
 Define and communicate a multi-year product vision and roadmap for Distribution, aligned to corporate strategy and our other industry editions. 
 Turn customer, partner, and market insight into prioritized market requirements that engineering can build against. 
 Build the business case for planned investments so leadership can make informed decisions on scope, timing, and tradeoffs. 
 Make deliberate build, buy, and partner choices, including where our ISV ecosystem should lead. 
 Bring AI into Distribution Workflows 
 Identify where AI should automate, assist, or keep a human in the loop across demand forecasting, replenishment, order exceptions, pricing, and warehouse operations. 
 Design for the trust, transparency, and control that operations teams require. 
 Define measurable outcomes such as inventory turns, fill rate, order accuracy, and time saved, and hold the roadmap accountable to them. 
 Know the Market and the Customer 
 Spend time with distributors, resellers, and ISV partners to understand how they run their operations and where Acumatica wins or loses.
 Track competitors and market trends and turn them into clear differentiation for sales and marketing. 
 Serve as the subject matter expert for Distribution inside and outside the company. 
 Deliver and Launch 
 Partner with engineering and UX on design, scope, and delivery, and review functional designs and release plans.
 Lead launch readiness across the organization: beta programs, early adopters, documentation and training review, and enablement for sales, support, and services.
 Create the collateral that makes new capabilities easy to sell, including demos, data sheets, and presentations.
 Monitor product quality and adoption metrics and drive improvements. 
 Support Customer and Partner Success 
 Resolve escalations from support, customer success, and implementation teams. 
 Contribute to knowledge base content and partner education. 
 What Success Looks Like 
 A Distribution roadmap that customers, partners, and internal teams rally behind. 
 Capabilities in the market that customers adopt and can measure.
 Stronger win rates, expansion, and retention in Distribution accounts.
 A healthy partner ecosystem extending the edition where it matters most.
Experience 
 7+ years of product management experience in business applications, in the ERP space.
 Direct domain experience in the distribution vertical market and product experience with inventory, warehouse management, order management, purchasing, and supply chain management.
 Track record of taking products from market requirements through launch with measurable results.
 Experience working with ISVs, partners, or other platform ecosystems. 
 Product and Business Skills 
 Strong roadmap and prioritization skills, with decisions tied to customer value and business outcomes. 
 Working knowledge of how distributors operate, including margin pressure, service levels, and channel complexity. 
 A blend of business and technical savvy, with comfort working in detail with engineers. 
 Clear written and verbal communication, including with executives, customers, and partners. 
 Hands-on fluency with LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval, and tool use, and a practical grasp of what they can do reliably. 
 Experience defining evaluation and quality approaches for AI in supply chain workflows, with accuracy, explainability, and human oversight. 
 A daily personal practice of using AI for product work, and the ability to model and teach it. 
 A clear point of view on how AI will change supply chain management, and the judgment to separate value from hype.
 Why Join Us 
 Most companies building AI-first ERP are starting with no customers. Most companies with customers are struggling to move fast on AI. This role gives you an established platform, a loyal customer base, a large partner channel, and the mandate and investment to lead the AI transformation of our distribution capabilities to support growing businesses. What you build shapes how growing distributors run their business on Acumatica.

WHAT YOU’LL DO: 
 CoolIT Systems is looking for an experienced Automation Engineer, Manufacturing to join our Calgary Manufacturing team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, programming, integrating, commissioning, and continuously improving automated manufacturing and product testing systems that support our growing production operations.
 The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with PLCs, HMIs, servo-motion systems, industrial or collaborative robots, and machine control technologies. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will lead automation projects from concept and system design through programming, integration, commissioning, documentation, operator training, and final production hand-off. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, optimizing manufacturing processes, and driving continuous improvement through automation.
 Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and implement automation solutions that transform manual and semi-automated manufacturing processes into fully integrated assembly and product testing systems.
 Develop controls architecture, functional requirements, machine sequences, I/O layouts, network architecture, and equipment integration strategies.
 Program, troubleshoot, and commission PLCs, HMIs, servo-motion systems, industrial and collaborative robots, and machine controls.
 Integrate automation components including PLCs, robots, vision systems, sensors, safety systems, pneumatics, test equipment, and industrial communication networks.
 Lead automation projects from concept and design through programming, testing, installation, commissioning, validation, production ramp-up, and final hand-off.
 Prepare technical documentation including project proposals, specifications, cost estimates, schedules, execution plans, SOPs, operating manuals, work instructions, and preventive maintenance procedures.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design machine layouts, tooling, fixtures, guarding, sensor placement, and equipment accessibility while ensuring manufacturability and reliability.
 Train engineers, technicians, and operators on equipment operation, robot programming, troubleshooting, and safe operating practices.
 Provide ongoing production support by troubleshooting complex automation and controls issues while driving equipment reliability and performance.
 Apply Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles to enhance throughput, product quality, safety, equipment reliability, cycle time, and operational efficiency.
 Ensure all automated equipment meets safety, quality, documentation, maintainability, and operator usability requirements before production release.   
 WHO YOU ARE:   
 Basic Qualifications:     
 Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechatronics, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. 
 Strong experience developing, troubleshooting, and commissioning PLC programs and HMI applications. 
 Experience programming, integrating, teaching, and commissioning industrial or collaborative robots. 
 Experience configuring, programming, tuning, and troubleshooting servo drives, servo motors, and motion-control systems. 
 Demonstrated experience delivering automated machinery from requirements and design through programming, commissioning, documentation, training, and final production hand-off. 
 Experience integrating PLCs, HMIs, robots, motion systems, safety devices, industrial networks, sensors, pneumatics, and test equipment. 
 Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, machine drawings, I/O lists, network diagrams, and control panel documentation. 
 Must be legally authorized to work in Canada without employer sponsorship. 
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 Working knowledge of IPC-A-610, ISO 9001, and Six Sigma methodologies. 
 Experience with SolidWorks or similar 3D CAD software. 
 Experience with SCADA, LabVIEW, embedded systems, Python, C/C++, SQL, or manufacturing data systems. 
 Experience working with Universal Robots, EPSON, FANUC, ABB, Yaskawa, or similar robotics platforms. 
 Experience creating machine SOPs, operating manuals, troubleshooting guides, and training documentation. 
 Skills:     
 Strong understanding of machine sequencing, operating modes, interlocks, alarms, diagnostics, industrial communications, and fault-recovery routines. 
 Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex automation issues. 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, manufacturing, and operations teams. 
 Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet project timelines, and develop practical solutions within budget and schedule constraints. 
 Strong computer skills and the ability to interpret technical data to support continuous improvement initiatives. 
 WHY COOLIT, AN ECOLAB COMPANY?     
 We strive to be an employer of choice and as such we believe in rewarding our employees with career and development opportunities that will maintain and strengthen our culture while aligning to our vision and values.    
 We are a company that is full of vibrant, innovative people who love what we do. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:    
 Vacation and flex days, and paid company-wide shutdown during the holiday season.   
 Comprehensive benefits including Dental, Drugs, Optical, Paramedical and Health Spending. These costs are covered by CoolIT and are enacted from your first day.   
 Dress for your day – in a casual yet professional environment.   
 Retention rewards like “The Big Coffee Break” that reward tenure with additional vacation time and a monetary bonus.   
 Company-funded RRSP contributions to support your long-term financial goals.   
 We thank every candidate in advance, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.    
 Successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo background checks including criminal records check and education.   
 About CoolIT Systems Inc.   
 Founded in Calgary, Alberta in 2001, CoolIT Systems is the leading Direct Liquid Cooling technology provider for data centers, supercomputers, and desktop computers. We design and manufacture solutions used by the largest tech companies globally.   
 Recognized as one of “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies 2023” by Financial Times and honored with the Deloitte Fast 50 Clean Technology award in 2022, as well as the Deloitte Fast 500 distinction in both 2021 and 2022, CoolIT's rapid growth is capturing global attention.

About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.



Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.



Our vision



We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.



But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.



Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.



In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.



Our traction



Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com http://Owner.com website.



More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.



Our team



Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.



We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.



Where we work



Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!





Why we’re looking for you



Lighthouse is Owner’s multi-location and scale initiative — the next chapter for customers who’ve experienced hyper-growth on the core platform and now need more advanced capabilities to keep scaling with us (not outgrowing us). Crucially, we do this on the one platform (not a separate “enterprise product”), so the most sophisticated features we build for multi-location brands trickle down to strengthen every single-location restaurant too — leveling the playing field by giving Davids “Goliath powers.”



We’re hiring a product leader to run Lighthouse end-to-end — a PM who wants to run and build a business line (product + operating model), and who is excited to be forward-deployed with our biggest customers. You’ll spend meaningful time in the field building relationships with sophisticated restaurant groups, and you’ll turn that signal into a scalable product + operating model. Our ambition is to start and scale a business line that can become $100M+ ARR.

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.



 The impact you'll have



 - Define and run the Lighthouse strategy and operating model: ICP, value prop, entitlements, and success metrics.

 - Build a differentiated Lighthouse customer experience across pre-sale, launch, and ongoing value delivery.

 - Partner tightly with Sales, Launch, Customer Success, Support, RevOps, and Engineering to keep deals moving and customers successful.

 - Drive the Lighthouse roadmap and ship multi-location capabilities into the one platform (not a fork).

 - Spend meaningful time with customers in the field and translate signal into shipped outcomes



Who you’ll work with



 - Report directly to VP Product.

 - Partner closely with leaders across Sales, Launch, CS/Support, RevOps, Marketing, and Engineering.



 What we’re looking for



 - 5+ years of Product Management experience.

 - Builder mindset — thrives in ambiguity, prototypes quickly, and learns by building.

 - Technically fluent — comfortable reading code, reasoning about systems, and partnering deeply with engineers.

 - Rapid prototyper — uses AI, SQL, Figma, no-code, or lightweight code to validate ideas and accelerate execution.

 - Strong product operator — proven track record of shipping high-impact products.

 - Customer obsessed — excels at discovery, relationship building, and translating customer needs into product direction.

 - Business-minded — understands unit economics, GTM strategy, and growth levers.

 - Cross-functional leader — aligns teams and drives decisions across engineering, design, and go-to-market.

 - Founder mentality — end-to-end ownership with an entrepreneurial approach; former founders are a strong plus.



Compensation and benefits



 - The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $275-300K, plus a generous pre-IPO equity package

 - Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!





Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.



We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.



Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.



Our vision



We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.



But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.



Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.



In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.



Our traction



Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com http://Owner.com website.



More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.



Our team



Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.



We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.



Where we work



Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!





Why we're looking for you

Owner is growing fast, and our Account Executive team is the engine of that growth. We’re looking for a sales-first Revenue Enablement Manager to own and progress the enablement program maturation specifically for our AE organization.


This role is ideal for someone who has lived the closing sales motion, as a top-performing Account Executive or Sales Leader, and is excited to apply that experience to building training, onboarding, and development programs that actually move the needle. We’re looking for a grinder and builder: someone who understands the nuances of discovery, deal cycles, pipeline management, demos, and negotiation because they’ve done it themselves.


Location: Toronto-based role with a hybrid schedule (2 days/week in-office). During monthly new-hire onboarding, this role is expected to be in-office 5 days/week (apx 2 weeks per month)


The Role

We're hiring a Revenue Enablement Manager to own AE enablement and drive measurable revenue impact. You'll build and execute an outcomes-focused enablement roadmap, ruthlessly prioritizing initiatives with the highest impact on sales performance, quota achievement, and revenue growth.


What You'll Own:

 - Program Strategy & Execution: Design and deliver the AE enablement roadmap with quarterly plans and monthly sprints. Roll out frameworks, playbooks, and training that directly correlate to rep productivity, deal velocity, and quota attainment. Measure everything against revenue outcomes.

 - New Hire Onboarding: Deliver, refine, and scale our AE onboarding program continuously. You'll be in-office for a significant portion of the program to drive hands-on training, coaching, and culture fit, essential for setting reps up to win. Your hybrid flexibility is critical to supporting this in-person collaboration.

 - Rep Development: Build and improve competency-based training programs in discovery, demos, pipeline management, and negotiation. Develop role-transition programs for BDR→AE advancement and leverage simulation tools for at-scale coaching and skill refinement.

 - Content Development & Improvement: Build and continuously improve eLearning modules, battlecards, playbooks, talk tracks, competitor guides, and process documentation. Create engaging, scalable content that drives adoption, retention, and measurable performance gains.

 - AI-Powered Enablement: Leverage AI tools to enhance training design, personalize learning paths, automate content creation, and drive measurable impact on sales performance. Stay ahead of enablement innovation to amplify team effectiveness.

 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with product, marketing, and RevOps to ensure enablement initiatives stay connected to business priorities, product updates, and frontline needs. Drive adoption of new sales frameworks and motions across the revenue org.
   

Who You Are

 - 3+ years of sales experience with real closing or quota-carrying exposure; ideally top-performer who understands deal cycles and the AE grind

 - 3-5 years in sales enablement, building and scaling programs that demonstrably drive revenue outcomes

 - Track record of translating sales motion and rep challenges into scaled training and development programs

 - Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce, Salesloft, Outreach, Avvara, and eLearning platforms (WorkRamp, etc.) for building and delivering training content

 - Outstanding coaching and facilitation skills, comfortable training groups, 1:1 coaching, and translating feedback into development plans

 - AI-Driven enablement innovator: Passion for leveraging AI to transform how we build and deliver enablement.

 - Organized, adaptable, and hyper-collaborative with leadership—an activator, not a blocker

 - Obsessed with measuring enablement's direct impact on revenue, pipeline, and quota attainment
   

Who You'll Work With

Your day-to-day partners are senior sales leaders and frontline managers, Sales Enablement leadership, marketing, product and the broader enablement team.

Pay and benefits

The base salary for this role is $140,000 - $160,000 CAD plus a generous pre-IPO equity package.


Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!





Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.



We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.
